query:
ALTER TABLE jobs 
  MODIFY COLUMN status ENUM('pending','extracting','translating','converting','done','error','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  ADD COLUMN cancelled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_logs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  jobId INT NOT NULL,
  seq INT NOT NULL,
  level ENUM('info','progress','success','warning','error') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_job_logs_jobId_seq (jobId, seq)
);
